title: Chennai Super Kings Name Zaheer Khan Head Coach for IPL 2027
excerpt: The five-time IPL champions ended Stephen Fleming's 16-year coaching era, handing former India pacer Zaheer Khan his first head-coach role on a one-year contract.
body:
• Chennai Super Kings have appointed former India fast bowler Zaheer Khan as head coach for IPL 2027, ending Stephen Fleming's 16-year tenure at the franchise.
  • Fleming, who led CSK as coach from 2009, delivered five IPL titles and two Champions League T20 trophies before stepping down in July 2026.
  • Zaheer, 47, served as Mumbai Indians' director of cricket operations from 2018 to 2022 and as Lucknow Super Giants' mentor until September 2025. The CSK job is his first as a head coach.
  • He signed a one-year contract, was appointed without an interview process, and has been given authority to pick his own coaching staff.

End of the Fleming era

The five-time IPL champions confirmed the appointment on Monday, September 21, bringing to a close the most successful coach-tenure in the league's history. Fleming's association with CSK began in 2008 as a player before he took over as coach the following year, building a dynasty that won the IPL in 2010, 2011, 2018, 2021 and 2023, plus two Champions League T20 titles.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=p9JJ_ysS1YI

The break was forced by results. CSK have not reached the playoffs since lifting the trophy three years ago in MS Dhoni's final season as full-time captain. A bottom-placed finish in 2025 prompted a philosophical shift — away from the experienced core the franchise had long trusted, toward young, unproven talent. The pivot produced Ayush Mhatre, Dewald Brevis and Kartik Sharma, but no turnaround on the field: an eighth-place finish in 2026, with six wins and eight losses, led Fleming to step down in July.

Why Zaheer

According to CSK managing director Kasi Viswanathan, Zaheer's name was discussed and agreed upon by the team's leadership group. The 47-year-old was appointed without going through any interview process and "readily" agreed to take up the role.

"We wanted to get the views of the cricket management including MS Dhoni, Ruturaj [Gaikwad] and Sanju [Samson]. There were a lot of discussions with the owners also."

— Kasi Viswanathan, CSK managing director

Zaheer's playing credentials need no introduction: 92 Tests, 200 ODIs and 17 T20Is for India, and the country's leading wicket-taker in the 2011 World Cup-winning campaign. In the IPL he played 100 matches and took 102 wickets — and faced CSK in both the 2010 and 2011 finals, losing each time to the side he will now coach.

His management résumé is just as relevant. At Mumbai Indians he first served as director of cricket operations and later as global head of development as the owners expanded into T20 teams around the world, working alongside head coach Mahela Jayawardene in back-to-back title-winning seasons in 2019 and 2020. He then joined Lucknow Super Giants as mentor, a role he held until September 2025.

"It's an honour to be a part of one of the most successful teams in the history of the IPL. The atmosphere created by the Superfans at Chepauk make it even more special."

— Zaheer Khan

A rebuild at Chepauk

Zaheer inherits a franchise in transition. The post-Dhoni era has been unsettled: the 2025 season ended at the bottom of the table, and while the youth-first course correction has unearthed talent, CSK have not yet found a formula that wins consistently. Viswanathan said Zaheer has been given a free hand to assemble his coaching staff, though the franchise has made no statement on the future of long-term assistants Eric Simmons and Michael Hussey.

The CSK owners' wider portfolio also remains in flux. While Albie Morkel has been named coach of the Joburg Super Kings in SA20, the Texas Super Kings in the USA's Major League Cricket are yet to announce a replacement for Fleming. Viswanathan confirmed Zaheer's role will be restricted to the IPL, according to Cricinfo.

What comes next

Zaheer is expected to begin his role soon, with the IPL retention window normally opening in November, though franchises have not yet been given a firm date. His first task will be shaping the squad for the 2027 season — deciding which of the young core stays, where experience must be added, and how to return a five-time champion to the playoffs. For a franchise that waited a full season to find Fleming's successor, the message is clear: this rebuild is now on Zaheer's shoulders.
